formation.explanation: Node/Peer proposals reach the leader, which appends current-term entries and sends predecessor-qualified replication. Followers reject mismatching prefixes or append matching entries, protect committed history and acknowledge accepted indexes. Engine persists ordinary responses before sending them (replication requests may precede persistence). Leader aggregates full-member and witness match values, selects the quorum index and commits only a current-term entry there, thereby carrying its prefix. Commit is propagated in replication/heartbeat messages; committed entries pass through a separate RSM queue to membership/application processing and client callbacks. Rejections retry with lower next; compacted histories use snapshots for active peers.

context.explanation: Election ticks on eligible full members trigger term increment and self-vote. Vote grants require vote eligibility and log freshness; known response admission and unique sender counting qualify election support. Promotion resets progress and adds a current-term no-op. Higher-term messages normally relinquish authority; stale terms are rejected, with a recent-leader exception for higher-term vote requests. Configured quorum checks revoke inactive leadership. Transfer pauses proposals, waits for a full target to catch up and sends TimeoutNow; timeout cancels transfer. Reset drops volatile pending reads and votes while retaining log history. Application of removal revokes local leadership; restart restores persisted term/vote/commit and snapshot membership.

connection.explanation: Only support qualified by current term/role and current membership advances formation; remote progress is rebuilt on authority reset while committed log history constrains future leaders through freshness and prefix checks. Pending configuration entries limit new proposals, and committed-but-unapplied work suppresses campaigning to avoid stale membership authority. RSM accepts legal configuration transitions then updates raft quorum membership. ReadIndex separately confirms current leadership only after current-term commitment, probes voting members and resolves a queued prefix; application and exact request context determine client completion. Old nonzero-term replies are filtered, pending read support is discarded on reset, and old log entries remain recoverable rather than being treated as current quorum proof.

grounding.derivation: ILogDB persistently stores Raft history and SaveRaftState atomically saves the supplied update. The merge test explicitly retains earlier indexes when replacing a later suffix. This check only appends, so deleting earlier entries is not part of its update. IKVStore/Pebble allow a returned read error distinct from absence; caller error propagation is a valid outcome. Prefix preservation on reported success follows independently of any promise to succeed under a read fault.
grounding.applicability: The obligation is local to the actual shard implementation reached by ShardedDB.SaveRaftStateCtx, not a claim that a cluster-level failure was reached.
